approval: Research owner, 2026-11-18, in this session: approve Amendment 1 under the listed restrictions (8e-6 only as the already-defined coordinate tie window; only planar native misses in that range without an actual wrong-surface hit become numerical ties; such samples are excluded from numerator and denominator and receive no radiance; the existing tie-rate gate is kept; the first failure log and replay evidence are preserved and the code before/after is recorded separately; full primary rerun in a new output directory with identical seeds and spp; stop without further tolerance expansion if the same kind of miss recurs, or if a miss outside the window or a wrong-surface hit is found).
trigger: Frozen primary at commit 2f9f5754e5c9e9a770cbf35dafee5f419e241a78 stopped at Stage 1, construction replica 0 (seed 10203101), membership {valid 328376813, buried 2814099, back 1731204, tie 763, invalid 1}. No evaluation stream had been traced and no held-out radiance existed. Read-only geometry replay (diag_membership.py, results/ecro_sss101g/primary_membership_replay.log): launch 57, slot 77555 (Box B patch 1211, bin 51), u1 = 5.960464477539062e-07 (5 float32 eps from the patch edge), native_valid false (no hit of any surface), analytic front cos 0.786.
change: AmendedOracle subclasses the unchanged WL101E ExposedOracle. After its classification, a proposal marked invalid is reclassified as a numerical tie only if (a) the native attachment query returned no hit (hits.is_valid() false, hence no wrong-surface hit), (b) the requested shape is planar (shape id != 6), and (c) min(u0, 1-u0, u1, 1-u1) <= 8e-6, the protocol's existing address_coordinate tie window used by WL101E's near_tie. u0 and u1 are regenerated from the identical PCG32 stream. Before: WL101E counted such planar misses as ties only within 4 float32 eps of the edge.
accounting: Reclassified samples join the tie count (excluded from numerator and denominator, never rerouted, no radiance). The unchanged tie-rate gate (<= 5e-5 of eligible proposals) applies to all ties. They are also counted separately as amended_tie.
stop: Any remaining invalid sample stops the run (gate invalid == 0 unchanged). Interpretation of 'the same kind of miss recurs': systematic recurrence, operationalised before the rerun as amended_tie > 1e-6 of eligible proposals in any replica (incident rate 3e-9), stops the run. No further tolerance expansion in any case.
rerun: Full primary from Stage 0 in results/ecro_sss101g/primary_a1 with all original seeds, spp, views, thresholds and analysis. The failed primary/ directory, primary.log, primary.exit and primary_membership_replay.log are preserved.
impact: Removes from the table estimate at most the reclassified samples (one observed in 3.3e8). The scientific measures, gates and decision rules are unchanged.
window_source: WL101E oracle_field.py near_tie threshold (<= 8e-6 in the u coordinates), unchanged.
